name: 🥐 Cheeseburger Puff Pastry Pockets
what: Cheeseburger filling baked inside golden puff pastry triangles.
early: Thaw the puff pastry in the fridge the night before.

core.name: Puff pastry (2 sheets)
core.out: tortillas, toasted in a pan like quesadillas

extras: onion, ketchup, mustard, pickles, sesame seeds

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Oven to 400°F, parchment on a pan.
Brown the beef (and onion). Drain, season. Stir in ketchup, mustard and pickles.
Cool 10 minutes, then stir in the cheese.
Cut each sheet into 4 squares. Fill, egg the edges, fold into triangles, seal with a fork.
Brush with egg, cut a slit on top. Bake. Cool 5 minutes before eating.

key: Cool the filling and add the cheese last, or the pockets leak.
plan_b: Pastry not thawed? Make it cheeseburger quesadillas in tortillas.
